title: TransformOperation
description: A JSON-serializable transform operation for the image cropper. AI agents can use these operations to programmatically crop, rotate, flip, and zoom images.

oneOf.title: Crop
oneOf.description: Crop the image to the given normalized rectangle.

oneOf.title: Rotate
oneOf.description: Rotate the image by the given number of degrees (0-360).

oneOf.title: Flip
oneOf.description: Flip the image along the given axis.

factor.description: Zoom factor where 1 means no zoom.

NormalizedRect.title: NormalizedRect
NormalizedRect.description: A rectangle with normalized coordinates (0-1 range relative to image dimensions). Origin is the top-left corner of the image.

x.description: Left edge position (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge).

y.description: Top edge position (0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge).

width.description: Width as a fraction of the image width.

height.description: Height as a fraction of the image height.
